# Alexander the Great Detailing

> Professional mobile car detailing in Cape Coral (33914), Fort Myers and surrounding Southwest Florida. We come to your home or workplace and detail cars, SUVs, trucks and minivans. Book online or call/text 239-517-0506.

- Phone: 239-517-0506 (call or text)
- Email: alexanderthegreatdetailing@gmail.com
- Service area: Cape Coral, Fort Myers and surrounding SWFL communities. A travel fee may apply outside the Cape Coral / Fort Myers area.
- First-time customers get 10% off (write "First-time customer" in the booking notes).
- Cash is preferred.

## Services and starting prices

Prices are by vehicle size: Sedan / SUV / Large SUV, Truck or Van. All prices are starting prices for vehicles in normal condition.

- [Interior Detailing](https://alexanderthegreatdetailing.com/#interior): $130 / $150 / $170. Vacuum, air blowout, dash, console, doors, cupholders, carpet and upholstery, leather conditioning, interior windows, floor mats.
- [Complete Interior & Exterior Detail](https://alexanderthegreatdetailing.com/#complete): $200 / $220 / $240. Everything in Interior Detailing plus foam bath and hand wash, wheels, tires and wheel wells, tire gloss, exterior windows, door jambs, hand dry, spray wax or paint sealant.
- [Deep Clean Package](https://alexanderthegreatdetailing.com/#deep-clean): $260 / $280 / $300. Complete detail plus extra deep cleaning. Family version includes one child car seat; Work Truck version targets mud, grease and job-site dirt.
- Family add-ons: one stroller $30, two strollers $50, one extra car seat $30, two extra car seats $50.
- Pet hair removal add-on: +$25 on any package.
- [Paint Enhancement & Protection](https://alexanderthegreatdetailing.com/#paint): custom quote. Clay bar, machine polishing, compound and finishing polish, ceramic spray protection, wax. No multi-year ceramic coatings.
- [Monthly Maintenance Membership](https://alexanderthegreatdetailing.com/#plan): two visits every month (one complete detail plus one interior refresher or exterior wash). No long-term contract. Call for a free quote.
